# mxroute_spam_settings (Resource)

Manage spam scoring with one Terraform owner per effective account. Saving affects shared account scoring and the selected domain; do not configure separate copies for different domains. The precise propagation across domains remains live-unverified. Create applies desired settings; import adopts them using an owned access domain as import ID. The stored ID is spam-settings. Destroy only relinquishes management and PRESERVES remote filtering; no reset/delete API exists. Changing access_domain updates in place. Unavailable settings are errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use one owner per effective account, across all owned domains.
resource "mxroute_spam_settings" "account" {
  access_domain = "example.com"
  high_score    = 15
  # Destroy relinquishes management and preserves remote filtering.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_domain` (String) Owned domain used to access shared settings. May change in place within the same effective account. A missing domain is an error, never proof that shared state disappeared.
- `high_score` (Number) High-score threshold, 1–50; lower means stricter filtering. Only this documented field is sent. Existing delivery policy determines rejection/discard behavior.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable account-relative identity, independent of access_domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_spam_settings.account example.com
```
